snippet.title: [PS1] Welcome House 2: Keaton and His Uncle - adventure from Gust
snippet.description:
Keaton's uncle is an avid practical joker with a messed up sense of humor. He rigged his house with all sorts of devious traps and explosives to mark the occasion of the Independence Day and play a prank on his unsuspecting nephew. Try and trigger them all!
 
Welcome House 2 was developed by a small Japanese company Gust responsible for the long-running Atelier series. Like all of their games for the original Playstation, it never left Japan. The first game also came out on the Saturn.
